name: Sample Research Pack
description: TASK-103 slice-1 sample pack: two dial-free preset tools demonstrating the manifest contract. pack_now pins the builtin current_time executor; pack_stamp pins uuid_hash with a fixed sha256 preset. Drop packs under plugins/<dir>/manifest.json — they appear in the tools registry after reload, and a pack never ships executable code.

tools.name: pack_now
tools.description: Current UTC time through the Sample Research Pack preset — a pinned flavor of the builtin current_time executor.

tools.name: pack_stamp
tools.description: Deterministic SHA-256 stamp of an input string — the pack-flavored content hashing preset of uuid_hash (callers pass value; the pack pins op=sha256).
